task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state with amplitudes proportional to [0.16, 0.86, 0.67, 0.34, 0.89, 0.65, 0.97, 0.39] using StatePreparation, then verifies the prepared statevector matches the normalized target. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
